[2026-05-31 13:52] CHORE-77 GREEN — task #7 is yours. Tiny, mechanical fix to the regression CHORE-76 introduced.

## Branch
`chore/nav-stacking-fix` (verify `git branch --show-current`; checkout if needed). Tallis RED is at `5473953`. NOTE: uncommitted memory files in the tree (bentham/tallis/test-gaps.md) — leave them, `git add` only `MvoxNav.svelte`.

## The fix — make Tallis's 3 RED tests pass
In `src/lib/components/MvoxNav.svelte`, on the `<header>` element ONLY:
1. **REMOVE** `overflow-x-hidden`. (This is the bug: `overflow-x: hidden` forces `overflow-y: auto` per CSS spec, clipping the `absolute top-full` dropdown panels — AvatarMenu logout + nav-tab-menu — on both desktop and mobile.)
2. **ADD** `relative` — gives the header a positioned stacking context.
3. **ADD** a `z-*` utility above page content — `z-30` (your call between z-30/z-40; the page content/DeskSurface is unpositioned, so z-30 is plenty). 

Leave the truncation mechanism as-is (`min-w-0` on nav-org-area, `flex-shrink-0` on nav-avatar-wrapper/nav-signin-wrapper/hamburger) — that's the correct horizontal-overflow control. Do NOT reintroduce any overflow clip on the header. Don't touch the panels or AvatarMenu internals.

## Verify
- `pnpm check` 0 errors · `pnpm test:unit` all green (the 3 formerly-RED now pass, all others stay green) · `pnpm lint` exit 0 (lint:fix first if needed) · `pnpm build`.
- Sanity: confirm the header still satisfies the CHORE-76 responsive tests (avatar visible, hamburger below sm, etc.) — should be untouched.

Commit (MvoxNav.svelte only) — atomic chaining + `MVOX_EXPECTED_BRANCH=chore/nav-stacking-fix`, no `Co-authored-by:` lines. Story Handoff to me when GREEN. Then idle.

## Make Tallis's RED pass (9 in LibraryMasterDetail.spec.ts + 12 in LibraryMobileList.spec.ts)

**Match these 3 seams EXACTLY (Tallis pinned them):**
- **(a) Row select = anchor.** Each `library-mobile-row` is an `<a>` with `href` containing `?work=<id>` (e.g. `?work=work-a`). NOT an imperative click→syncUrl handler — an anchor, so back button + tests work without JS.
- **(b) Scroll-spy gate.** Construct the IntersectionObserver only when `window.matchMedia('(min-width: 640px)').matches` is true. In jsdom matchMedia → `matches:false`, so the observer must never be constructed `<sm` (test replaces IntersectionObserver with a throwing spy — component must not throw).
- **(c) View mode = existing `initialWorkId` prop.** On `LibraryMasterDetail`: `initialWorkId == null` → render mobile list; non-null → render mobile detail. No new prop.

## Implementation per contract
- `src/routes/library/+page.svelte` — `library-task-cards` testid + `hidden sm:grid` on the task-card grid; gate the top-bar `w-[280px]` desktop search to `sm:` (hidden `<sm`).
- `LibraryMaster.svelte` — `data-testid="library-master"` on root + `hidden sm:block`.
- `LibraryMasterDetail.svelte` — wrap the 2-col grid with `library-md-grid` gated `sm:grid` (single-col `<sm`). Below `sm`: `initialWorkId==null` → `<LibraryMobileList>`; else → `library-mobile-detail` containing the existing `LibraryWorkPaperStack` for the selected work + `library-mobile-back` (an `<a>`/button to clear `?work=`, label `m.library_back_to_works()`). Gate scroll-spy per seam (b).
- Create `LibraryMobileList.svelte` — props: works array (existing library types). Sticky search input `library-mobile-search` (placeholder `m.library_mobile_search_placeholder()`), `$state` query, `$derived` filtered works (case-insensitive substring on title OR composer). Render `library-mobile-row` per filtered work as an `<a href=…?work=<id>>` (title, composer, edition count, chevron; `data-work-id`). Empty → `library-mobile-empty` with `m.library_search_no_results()`.

`pnpm check` 0, `pnpm test:unit` all green (21 formerly-RED pass, existing green), `pnpm lint` exit 0 (lint:fix first), `pnpm build`. Confirm desktop (`sm`+) unchanged.
